title: Invert Tabs
description: One pill tab bar on warm white: Albums, Singles, Live, Demos. A black highlight springs between the tabs, and the labels invert exactly where it covers them, so mid-travel a letter is half black and half white inside a single glyph. Drag along the bar to scrub the highlight through the words; let go and it snaps to the nearest tab with the speed you threw it at.
intent: Translate the exclusion-tabs technique from https://paco.me/craft/tabs: a duplicated, inverted label row clipped to the highlight, so colour flips at the pill edge rather than per label, set as a hero object under the house type law.
